project.purpose: Compose mature DNS/proxy/tunnel/failover mechanisms into isolated network paths and prove workload-relevant behavior with independent acceptance evidence without becoming a custom network stack.

nodes.label: RequirementClassifier
nodes.responsibility: Classify the network requirement and select a mature mechanism rather than inventing a local stack.
acceptance: Generic core stays independent of provider/consumer profiles.

nodes.label: DataPlaneComposition
nodes.responsibility: Realize DNS/proxy/tunnel/failover using mature external components and isolated topology.
acceptance: Live unit remains a bounded replaceable composition.

nodes.label: ProbeEvidence
nodes.responsibility: Observe functional/lifecycle behavior with black-box metrics and exact acceptance evidence.
acceptance: Local WSL capability projection is refreshed only after acceptance gates pass.

nodes.label: FaultAcceptance
nodes.responsibility: Falsify relevant failure modes using deterministic fault injection and reference-Linux lanes.
acceptance: DNS/transport/recovery faults have explicit acceptance evidence.

nodes.label: ProviderConsumerProfiles
nodes.responsibility: Keep optional provider- and consumer-specific profiles outside generic graduation prerequisites.
acceptance: Adding a profile does not redefine generic Network acceptance.

slices.objective: Keep future provider/consumer additions optional and evidence-scoped; do not expand generic core without a cross-workload need.
acceptance: A new profile can be admitted without changing generic Network graduation unless evidence shows a missing generic mechanism.
slices.nextAction: Apply this gate to the next provider/consumer request.

review.notes: Initial project-native LEGO planning projection. It does not replace owner-native architecture or evidence.
